definitions.explanation: The ability to continue despite difficulties.

examples.japanese: {根気|こんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いる→要る：09589_iru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧
{根気|こんき}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。

⟦{語学|ごがく}→語学：02770_gogaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{根気|こんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}かない→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{上達|じょうたつ}→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: You won't easily improve at language study if you can't stick with it.

notes:
{根気|こんき} means "patience" or "perseverance"—the ability to persist through difficulties over time.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {根気|こんき}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: patiently, persistently
- {根気|こんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→要る：09589_iru⟧: to require patience
- {根気|こんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to have staying power
- {根気|こんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}かない→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to lose patience, give up easily
- {根気|こんき}⟦{強|づよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: persevering, patient

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- {根気|こんき}: sustained patience for long-term effort
- ⟦{忍耐|にんたい}→忍耐：05212_nintai⟧: endurance, bearing hardship
- ⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}→辛抱：05101_shinbou⟧: patience, putting up with something

USAGE: Often used when describing work or learning that requires persistent effort.
